=
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr.Dilip Kumar Roy  For the Opposite Party/s : Mr.Mohammed Arif  ======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE ARVIND SRIVASTAVA
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

Petitioner apprehends arrest in connection with Mohiuddin Nagar P.S. Case No. 10 of 2022 registered for the offence under sections 323, 504, 506, 498A/34 of the Indian Penal Code and sections 3/4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that petitioner has not committed any offence as alleged in the first information report and he has been falsely implicated in this case.
Petitioner is still ready to keep his wife with full honour and dignity.
The petitioner is ready to pay Rs. 2000/- per month to his wife for her maintenance, as stated in the supplementary Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.41697 of 2022(7) dt.17-05-2023 affidavit.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case and the submissions advanced on behalf of the parties, the petitioner, above named, is directed to be released on bail on furnishing personal bond to the satisfaction of Additional Chief Judicial Magistate IV, Samastipur in connection with Guddu Abhilasa @ Mukesh Kumar vs The State Of Bihar on 17 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/79684469/
1 Mohiuddin Nagar P.S. Case No. 10 of 2022 subject to the conditions as laid down under section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure.
